title: Stage 5.3 Target-Ratio Spatial Composition — Formal Baseline (CMP-0 vs CMP-1, Dev166 frozen Full Dev artifact)

preregistration.precondition: stage5_3_smoke DEVELOPMENT_SMOKE_COMPLETE (14/14 engineering gates PASS); no Formal result existed or was read at preregistration time

stage5_2_freeze_identity.artifact_audit: 2026-09-09 AutoDL preflight: 166 shards intact, merge 51,256 frames missing/extra/duplicate=0, semantic hashes byte-verified, model_error=0

interpretation_boundary: this experiment verifies geometry validity, subject visibility, off-center benefit, near-center behaviour, multi-subject risk, fallback behaviour and determinism
it does NOT and cannot claim that CMP-1 improves the official competition score
weak-reference IoU is diagnostic only and never a promotion gate

research_questions.Q1: Does CMP-1 keep 100% engineering validity over all 51,256 frozen frames (frame identity, in-bounds, exact target ratio)?
research_questions.Q2: In which model-blind geometry strata does CMP-1 improve subject visibility over CMP-0 across Dev166, and by how much?
research_questions.Q3: What is the selected-primary overflow profile (>0/>1/>3/>5/>10 px) and sanitized-invalid count over the frozen Full Dev artifact?

in_scope: read-only consumption of the frozen Stage 5.2 Full Dev artifact (/root/autodl-tmp/outputs/stage5/stage5_2_full_dev/)
CMP-0 vs CMP-1 position-only composition over 51,256 frozen frames
subject visibility / center containment / crop shift metrics and strata comparison
selected-primary overflow audit on the full artifact
FULL_FRAME_SUBJECT_DIAGNOSTIC and multi_subject_diagnostic on the full artifact
weak-reference diagnostic (NOT official GT, NOT for model selection)

inputs.shard_integrity: every Stage 5.2 shard rechecked via its status file (frame count + byte sha256) before composition

strata.feature: horizontal center offset |cx/W - 0.5| of the sanitized primary bbox (model-blind geometry)
strata.inherits: identical thresholds to the frozen stage5_3_smoke_manifest_v1

confirmatory_dev136.name: Dev136_confirmatory
confirmatory_dev136.definition: Dev166 minus the 30 whole video_ids of stage5_3_smoke_manifest_v1 (SHA 97b54d29bc8dc7c3241097c595f8377615fc24efe0235d2678de3e39b2b23c74)
confirmatory_dev136.role: confirmatory development subset for post-hoc analysis / NOT Heldout / NOT official validation / NOT official GT

diagnostics.multi_subject_diagnostic: per ambiguous frame: primary class, composition class (person+person / person+other / nonperson_multi), secondary count, secondary centers, secondary-center containment per CMP-0/CMP-1, all-contained / at-least-one-contained ratios; observation only
diagnostics.fallback_reason_diagnostic: per frozen fallback reason (BOX_TOO_LARGE / LOW_CONFIDENCE / BOX_TOO_SMALL / FULL_FRAME_LIKE / NO_DETECTION / other frozen reasons): count, ratio, trigger class distribution, trigger bbox area ratio; observation only, no reclassification
diagnostics.full_frame_subject_diagnostic: BOX_TOO_LARGE frames with mirrored trigger candidate and hypothetical CMP-1 visibility; observation only
diagnostics.weak_reference_diagnostic: weak IoU CMP-0 vs CMP-1, paired win/tie/loss; DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY / NOT official GT / NOT for model selection

all_must_pass: Stage 5.2 artifact modified = NO (shard status recheck + policy semantic SHA)
official-format emission validated for CMP-0 and CMP-1 (0 violations)
diagnostic mirror cross-check vs frozen PRIMARY decisions: mismatches = 0

determinism_note: pure CPU geometry; deterministic replay compares the canonical SHA of all frame records
next_step_gate: STAGE5_3_REPORT only after all gates PASS; CMP-2 (adaptive center/subject) may be proposed in a NEW protocol if smoke+formal evidence supports it
